tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅// lhag pa'i lha rab 'byams la sbyar du rung ba'i mchod phreng mchod sprin rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ 'dir rnal 'byor pa gang zhig rang gi lhag pa'i lha gang yang rung ba'i dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa la sogs pa'i dus skabs ji ltar rigs par mchod yul rnams la mchod pa 'bul ba'i tshig gi phreng ba mdo rgyud rang rang gi babs dang mthun par sbyar bar 'os pa'i mchod phreng mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnam dag las byung zhing yongs su grags pa 'ga' zhig btsal sla ba dang nye bar mkho ba'i ched phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa la/ thog mar mdo lugs dkon mchog ta la las byung ba'i mchod phreng las nye bar spyod pa'i mchod pa khol du byung ba ni/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla bre dang*// mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye zhing*// mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas// bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba sras bcas mchod// sngags spel na/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta'am/ sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwā sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ mchod yon gyi gnas su zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri mchog zhal zas/ sil snyan rnams dang*/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su pā d+yaṃ/ paṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yā/ shab+da rnams bcug cing*/ mchod sprin gyi gzungs rol mo dang bcas pa bya/ de bzhin du/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams// sangs rgyas sras dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas 'gro ba'i don kun mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ sogs gong ltar sbyar/ mchod yon dang*/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ me tog dang*/ puṣ+pe la sogs pa 'byin 'jug bgyis te brjod do// rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di// ji snyed rgyal ba sras dang bcas// de snyed rnams la bdag 'bul na// thug rje mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis// ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang*// sems can don kun mdzad du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/

zhes sogs chu gnyis yod na zhabs bsil nas/ shab+da'i bar sbyar zhing*/ 'di dag la dharma ra ṇi ta sogs kyis byin brlab bo// de rnams la sogs pa spyir 'gro ba dang*/ bye brag rgyud sde bzhi'i mchod phreng dmigs kyis bsal ba ni/ thog mar bya rgyud legs grub las gsungs pa ni/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i// sngags kyi mchod yon mchog 'di dag /mchog tu dad pas khyod la 'bul// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i// sngags kyi zhabs bsil mchog 'di dag /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ oṃ pra ba ra sat+k+wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ gtsang zhing gtsang ma las skyes pa'i// lha rdzas kyi ni me tog 'di// bdag gis dad pas= /bzhes nas bdag la= /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta puṣ+pe pū dza= gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar skyes pa'i// lha rdzas dam pa'i dri 'di dag /bdag gis= /bzhes nas= /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gan+dhe pū dza= /dri yis rgyas pa lha yi rdzas// nags tshal bcud ni yid 'ong dag /bdag gis= /bzhes nas= /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dhū pe pū dza= sman rnams bcud ni yi gar 'ong*// sngags kyi zhal zas bcud 'di dag /bdag gis= /bzhes nas= /oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā d+ya nu twan+na twā ta pū dza= gnod rnams 'joms shing bkra shis la// dge zhing mun pa rnam sel 'di// bdag gis= /bzhes nas= /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā lo ke pū dza= de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan// sems can sdug bsngal sim byed pa'i// sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shab+da pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes so// de nas rnal 'byor gyi rgyud sogs gong ma rnams kyi mchod phreng ni/ 'jig rten 'di'am phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// 'khor los sgyur ba'i rig pas byin brlabs pa'i// lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed mchis pa kun// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul bar bgyi// mchod yon ma'i las rgya bcings la ar+ghaṃ sogs dang*/

de bzhin du me tog nas/ rol mo'i bar dang*/ puṣ+pe nas shab+da'i bar dang*/ phyag rgya bcing ba rigs 'gre/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis dpral ba'i thad du na bza' 'dzin tshul byas pa dang*/ 'jig rten 'di'am= /kha dog bzang zhing dri zhim reg na bde// srab 'jam yang ba'i ras zung ji snyed kyang*// rgyal ba sras dang= /sngags rnams gong ltar gyi rjes su oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra/ lag g.yon mnyam gzhag dang g.yas kyi thal mo kha thur bstan dpral ba'i thad nas g.yas skor byas pa dang*/ 'jig rten= /rin chen bla re yid 'ong rgyan dang ldan// chen po'i nyer spyod bde ba sgrub pa yang*// rgyal ba= bi tā naṃ/ lag g.yon pa'i mthil du g.yas pa'i lag ngar gyen du bsgrengs pa'i gru mo btsugs pa dang*/ 'jig rten= /lha rdzas las byung sna tshogs mdog dang ldan// ba dan yid 'ong phyogs bcur g.yo ba yang*// rgyal ba= /pa taṃ ka g.yon snying gar de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu tshur gyis mthe bo bsgrengs pa'i steng nas g.yas pa'i thal mo kha sbub pa dang*/ 'jig rten= /rin chen gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can// 'khor yug rgyan gyi rnam pa yid 'ong ldan// rgyal ba= /ts+tsha traṃ ga lag ngar gnyis g.yas g.yon so sor gyen du bsgrengs pa'i srin lag gnyis bkug gung mdzub gshibs te bsgreng*/ mthe bo mthe'u chung so sor bsgreng*/ 'jig rten= /rin chen rgyal mtshan nor bu'i tog gis spras// bdud kyi dgra las rgyal ba'i ba dan 'phyar// rgyal ba= /dh+wa dza/ sngags rnams gong ltar brjod/ 'jig rten= /kha dog dbyibs legs dri zhim yid 'ong ba'i// me tog sna tshogs skye ba'i shing rnams kyang*// rgyal ba= /me tog ma'i las rgya sogs byed pa 'gre bas/ oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ se gol gtogs te/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ 'jig rten= /bsil zhing dri zhim reg na gdung ba sel// yid 'phrog dri mchog ji snyed yod pa yang*// rgyal ba=

/thog mtha'i sngags dang phyag rgya 'dra bas/ oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐/ 'jig rten= /ga bur la sogs legs par sbyar ba yi// lha rdzas bdug pa'i spos sprin 'khrigs pa yang*// rgyal ba= /oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ 'jig rten= /lha rdzas las byung rin chen sgron me 'bar// phyogs bcu'i mun pa kun du sel ba yang*// rgyal ba= oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hūm̐/ 'jig rten= /kha dog bzang zhing dri zhim ro brgya ldan// swasti ka sogs zhal zas sna tshogs kyang*// rgyal ba= /oṃ ā ka ro sogs/ pi waṃ la sogs rol mo'i khyad par bcu// rnar snyan yid 'ong sgra snyan ci mchis pa// rgyal ba= /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis rol mo rdung tshul dang rol mo byed/ oṃ badz+ra hūm̐ khaṃ/ badz+ra hūm̐ ghūm̐/ badz+ra hūm̐ te/ badz+ra hūm̐ s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra trī te/ badz+ra traṃ ka badz+ra dhā tu/ badz+ra ḍau bu dha/ oṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ rdo rje gar ma'i phyag chen byed cing*/ 'jig rten= /legs par sbyar ba'i gar mkhan rol mo ba// rab mdzes dga' ba'i rtsed 'jo byed pa kun// rgyal ba= /oṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis dpral bar bzhag pa dang mkhrig ma g.yas g.yon snyan g.yas g.yon la bzhag pa dang*/ brang la do shal dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ dpung rgyan g.yas g.yon dang*/ de'i 'og sor bzhir srung skud dang*/ rked rgyan dang*/ zhabs gdub rnams 'bul tshul byed cing*/ 'jig rten= /lha rdzas rin chen las grub cod pan dang*// gdu bu rna rgyan la sogs rgyan mchog kun// rgyal ba= /sngags gnyis 'og ma thams cad la 'dra/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis las gung mdzub gnyis bshibs te brkyang ba lan gcig phyir bskor nas slar nang du bskor ba lag g.yas g.yon du brkyang tshul/ 'jig rten= /phyogs rnams kun tu legs par dpyangs pa yi// mdzes pa'i dar dpyangs khyad 'phags yod pa kun// rgyal ba= /phreng ba ma'i las rgya byed de// 'jig rten=

/dri zhim mal+li ka dang legs spel ba'i// rin chen me tog phreng ba mdzes pa yang*// rgyal ba= khu tshur gnyis kyis rnga yab g.yob tshul dang*/ g.yon snying gar bzung*/ g.yas pa'i gung mdzub gnyis brkyang ba thur bstan gyis de'i steng du gzhal yas khang gru bzhi'i dbyibs byed cing*/ rin chen rnga yab drwa ba drwa phyed dang*// zla phyed nor bu'i rgyan spras gzhal med khang*// rgyal ba= khu tshur kha sbyar ba'i gung srin brkyang mthe bo gnyis bsgreng ba rna ba ltar byas pa rta'i rgya dang*/ 'jig rten= /bde ba'i gnas su myur ba'i shugs kyis bgrod// dgra las rgyal byed cang shes rta yi khyu// rgyal ba= /g.yon pa'i lag mthil du g.yas pa'i lag ngar bsgrengs pa'i gru mo btsugs pa'i khu tshur thur du bkug pa'i gung mo sna ltar brkyang ba glang po che'i rgya dang*/ 'jig rten= /shin tu stobs ldan rin chen drwa bas spras// dgra 'joms bzhon pa'i mchog gyur glang chen khyu// rgyal ba= thal mo khong stong dang*/ 'jig rten= /gnas chen rnams kyi 'dod pa'i don sgrub pa'i// nyer spyod 'dod 'jo'i ba la sogs pa'i khyu// rgyal ba= /'jig rten= /rta babs yid 'ong dril bu la sogs pa'i// rgyan gyis spras pa phyogs bcur bkod pa yang*// rgyal ba= /thal mo khong stong dang*/ oṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes mchod pa nyer gcig pas mchod la/ mchod pa nyi shu pa ni logs nas 'byung ste 'dir yang spro na tshigs bcad dang sngags tsam gyis bya/ mchod pa nyer lnga pa ni/ dpag med bsod nams stobs las byung ba yi// lha rdzas las grub rin chen cod pan mchog /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na mu ku ṭa pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad kyi tshig gnyis pa dang*/ sngags kyi rat+na mu ku ṭa'i gnas su rim bzhin/

snyan shal mdzes byed rin chen 'khyil pas brgyan// rat+na kuṇ+ḍa laṃ/ mgrin pa dung 'dra mdzes byed mgul gdub mchog /rat+na har+ṣa/ thugs mchog dpal be'u mdzes byed se mo do// rat+na a ba hā ra/ dpung pa mdzes byed dpung brgyan srung skud mchog /rat+na ke yū ra/ phyag gnyis mkhrig ma spras pa'i gdu bu mchog /rat+na pa ri ka ḍa kaṃ/ drwa bas 'brel ba'i sor mo'i gdu bu mchog /rat+na pa kaṃ ba la/ rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i zhabs la mdzes byed rgyan// rat+na pā da bha ra ṇaṃ/ rin chen gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can// rat+na ts+tsha traṃ ga mi mthun bdud las rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan mchog /rat+na dh+wa dza/ snyan pa phyogs bcur g.yo ba'i ba dan 'phan// rat+na pa taṃ ka phyogs kun yid 'phrog dar gyi lda ldis spras// rat+na pa ḍa da ma/ gdung sel rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can// rat+na tsā ma ra// rin chen rgyan 'od ldan pa'i bla re bri// rat+na bi tā naṃ/ mi 'jigs bzhi ldan seng ge'i gdan la sogs// rat+na siṃ ha ā sa na/ lha rdzas yid 'ong mdzes byed gzims cha'i tshogs// sha ya nā sa na/ nyon mongs grwa zur spangs pa'i pho brang zlum// pa ri maṇ+ḍa le dha n+ya/ yon tan rgyas pa'i gru bzhi gzhal med khang*// a me ya tsa tur+tha/ 'jig rten las 'das gru bzhi nyis brtsegs khang*// dwi kū ṭa ga raṃ/ rang bzhin 'od gsal byang sems zla ba'i gdan// tsan+d+ra ā sa na/ 'dod pa'i 'dam gyis ma gos me tog mchog /puṣ+pe/ stong nyid sgra sgrogs pi waṃ ting ting shag /wī ṇi/ thabs la mkhas pa zag med phung po'i dri// gan+dhe/ nyon mongs bkres sel chos kyi zhal zas mchog /nai wi d+ya/ ngo tsha khrel yod ldan pa lha yi gos// was+t+ra/ zhes bcug pa'i mchod pa nyer lnga/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi khyad par gyi mchod pa ni/ sgeg sogs brgyad ni/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa na// oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye hūm̐/ rdo rje rin chen bla na med// oṃ badz+ra mā le tram̐/

rdo rje chos ni glu blangs pa// oṃ badz+ra gī tī hrīḥrdo rje las kun byed par 'gyur// oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+ye āḥ oṃ badz+ra satwa su saṃ gra ha ta/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ badz+ra rat+na ma nut+ta raṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe trāṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dharma gā ya nai/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hrīḥ badz+ra karma ka rod+bha wa/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dha āḥ rgyal srid sna bdun ni/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la// 'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad nas// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /tsakra rat+na pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la// nor bu rin chen= /bkres shing phongs pa rgyun bcad nas// 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /ma ṇi rat+na= btsun mo rin chen= /ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad nas// shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs shing*// thabs dang shes rab ldan par shog /s+t+rī rat+na= blon po rin chen= /phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan// bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing*// yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /pu ru ṣa rat+na= glang po rin chen= /lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal nas// bla med theg par rab zhon te// thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /ha sti rat+na= rta mchog rin chen= /srid pa'i gzeb las yongs grol te// rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas// sangs rgyas zhing kun 'grod par shog /tu raṃ ga a shwa rat+na= dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas// nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas// phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de// bsnyengs bral mchog ni thob par shog /khaḍ+ga rat+na= 'dod yon lnga ni/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan tshig mchog sgra snyan ci mchis pa// mos blos sogs tshig tha ma gnyis 'dra/

shab+da/ phyogs dus kun na tsan+dan sbrul snying dang*// a gar la sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams// gan+dhe/ phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lus sems rtas byed ro mchog ci mchis pa// ra sa/ phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshim byed rnams// spar+she/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad ni/ me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po na// ye shes rgya mtsho mchog tu dag gyur te// rnam dag chos la thogs med longs spyod pa'i// bkra shis des kyang rgyal rnams mchod par bgyi// ā dar+sha pū dza me gha sogs/ gi waṃ dug gsum 'joms pa nad kyi sman// sman mchog chos nyid rab tu rtogs gyur nas// nyon mongs zung rngu med par gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang= /go ro tsa na/ zho ni kun gyi snying por gyur pa ste// snying po rnam dag ye shes rnams rtogs nas// yon tan kun gyi dbyings su gyur pa yi// bkra shis= /da dhi/ dūrbas tshe ni 'phel bar byed pa ste// rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni rab sgrub cing*// nyon mongs skye shi rgyun chad gyur pa yi// bkra shis= /dūrba/ bilba rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun// byang chub snying po mchog tu gyur pa yi// bkra shis= /bilba/ dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgrogs pa'i tshul// ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du dag gyur te// chos rnams ma nor yongs su ston pa yi// bkra shis= /shaṃ kha/ li khri dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin can// chos rnams ma lus dbang du bsdus nas kyang*// chos kyi rgyal srid rab tu brtan gyur pa'i// bkra shis= /sin+dhū ra/ yungs kar rdo rje'i rigs te thams cad du// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms par byed pa ste// mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs pa yi// bkra shis= /sar+ṣa bha/ bkra shis rtags brgyad ni/ mgon po thugs rje chen pos byin brlabs pa'i// bsod nams rgyu las byung ba'i 'khor lo 'di// gang la phul ba de yi skad cig la// dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog

/tsakra maṅga laṃ pū dza me gha sogs/ mgon po= /dri med shin tu mdzes pa'i dpal be'u 'di// gang la= /kun mkhyen ye shes nyid dang ldan par shog /a wa hā ra maṅga laṃ/ mgon po= /rin chen bcud kyis gang ba'i bum pa 'di// gang la= /bsod nams tshogs rdzogs rgyan gyis brgyan par shog /ka la sha maṅga laṃ/ mgon po= /dri med shin tu dag pa'i pad+ma 'di// gang la= /'khor ba'i nyes pa'i skyon gyis ma gos shog /pad+ma maṅga laṃ/ mgon po dri med shin tu dkar ba'i dung chen 'di// gang la= /rtsod ngan pham byed chos sgra sgrogs par shog /shaṅkha maṅga laṃ/ mgon po= /dri med shin tu dag pa'i gser nya 'di// gang la= /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho che las sgrol bar shog /nyā tsha maṅga laṃ/ mgon po= /skyabs kyi dam pa rin chen gdugs mdzes 'di// gang la= /kun la skyabs kyi dam pa byed par shog /ts+tsha traṃ maṅga laṃ/ mgon po= /dam chos mi nub rgyal mtshan dam pa 'di// gang la= /dam chos mi nub rgyal mtshan 'dzugs par shog /dh+wa dza maṅga laṃ/ de rnams ni rgyas pa'o// 'bring du byed na tshigs bcad dor te sngags tsam gyis bya/ bsdu na/ zhing 'di rin chen sna bdun gyis// mkhas pa dag gis yongs bkang ste// dngos grub 'dod pa sbyin pa'i phyir// nyin rer shes rab can gyis 'bul// sap+ta rat+na pū dza me gha= dpag yas bsod nams tshogs las grub pa yi// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs// zhing khams 'di dang rab 'byams zhing gzhan rnams// bkang ste bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pū dza me gha= lha yi dbang po lha min g.yul rgyal te// bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ltar// rgyal ba rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' la// bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyi// aṣ+ṭa maṅga la dra bya pū dza= gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar byas pa'i// lha rdzas bkra shis rtags brgyad 'di// bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// aṣ+ṭa maṅga laṃ ku ru pū dza=

/zhes pas bya'o// gsang ba yum bzhes mchod pa ni// byang chub sems ni brten bskyed nas// bdag ni sangs rgyas yin bsam zhing*// dga' bas bdag ni mchod byed na// sangs rgyas kyi ni bde ba'ang thob// pad kor 'khyud rgya bcas te/ bud+dha āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ tshig rkang dang po gnyis 'dra bar// phreng ba la sogs rab mchod pas// mchod na de ni dbang yang bskur// rdo rje rin chen gyi dam rgya spyi bor bzhag ste/ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ snyan pa'i glu yis rab mchod pas// mchod na dga' bde mgu bar 'gyur// chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya bcings te/ bud+dha stu te ka ro mi/ gar gyi mchod pas bdag mchod na// sangs rgyas kyis kyang de mchod 'gyur// gar ma'i las rgya bcings te/ bud+dha pū dza ka ro mi/ zhes gsang ba yum bzhi'i mchod pa dang*/ de nas/ oṃ sarba bit+pū ra pu ra/ su ra su ra/ ā brta ya ā warta ya hoḥ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes pas kyang mchod/ de rnams rgyas par tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas/ bsdu na sngags tsam gyis bya/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi gtso bo rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor las gsungs pa'i mchod phreng ngo*// bla med la dang po pha rgyud kyi mchod phreng la/ thog mar gsang 'dus nas gsungs pa ni/ lha yi mchod yon dam pa 'dis// dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyid par 'tshal// thugs ni brtse bar nyer dgongs te// mgon pos mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ chu skyes de bzhin thang las skyes// me tog dam pa 'di dag ni// mchog tu gus pas bdag 'bul na// ci bde bar ni khyed kyis bzhes// puṣ+pe/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar las byung*// de bzhin bdug spos mchog 'di dag /mchog tu gus pas bdag 'bul na// ci bde bar ni khyod kyis bzhes// dhū paṃ/ zhun mar 'bru mar mar me 'di// lha rdzas 'bar bas mun pa 'joms// mi shes thams cad zhi bya'i phyir// bdag nyid dad pas 'bul bar bgyi// dī paṃ/

lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi// dri mchog dam pa 'di dag ni// mchog tu dad pas bdag 'bul na// ci bde bar ni khyed kyis bzhes// gan+dhaṃ/ bza' dang bca' ba yang dag ldan// kha dog dri dang ro ldan zhing*// thams cad sbyar ba'i zhal zas 'di// 'bul gyis yang dag bzhes su gsol// nai wi d+yaṃ/ sil snyan la sogs rol mo'i tshogs// dbyangs kyi nga ro ldan pa 'di// mchog tu dad pas bdag 'bul gyi// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ rin chen dbang gi rgyal po bai ḍū+ir+ya'i// sngon po la sogs kha dog dbyibs kyi gzugs// rnam gsum gzugs kyi rdo rje mar byas nas// dkyil 'khor lha yi spyan la dbul bar bgyi// lag pa g.yon rdo rje khu tshur du byas pa'i mdzub mo'i tshigs bar par/ g.yas thal mo brkyangs pa'i mkhrig ma gyen du bslangs te bzhag pa me long gi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥrū pa badz+rī hūm̐/ zhes pas gzugs dang*/ ma zin 'byung po'i tshogs pa las byung ba'i// brjod bral dbyangs la sogs pa sgra yi tshogs// rnam gsum sgra yi rdo rje mar byas nas// dkyil 'khor lha yi snyan la dbul bar bgyi// zhes pas rol mo dbul/ shab+da badz+rī/ zhes pas sgra dang*/ ga bur a gar dzā ti la sogs pa// legs par sbyar ba'i byug pa dri yi tshogs// rnam gsum dri yi rdo rje mar byas nas// dkyil 'khor lha yi shangs la dbul bar bgyi// g.yon rdo rje khu tshur gyis dung chos 'dzin pa'i tshul dang*/ g.yas mtheb mdzub sbyar nas sor mo lhag ma gsum brkyangs pa'i rtses dri chu blangs te lha rnams la byug pa'i tshul du byas la/ gan+dhe badz+rī/ zhes pas dri dang*/ lus mchog rtas byed bdud rtsi'i zas la sogs// mngar skyur kha dang bska la sogs pa'i ro// rnam gsum ro yi rdo rje mar byas nas// dkyil 'khor lha yi ljags la dbul bar bgyi// rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya dang*/

ra sa badz+rī/ zhes pas ro dang*/ lus la reg pa tsam gyis bde ster ba// dpag bsam gos la sogs pa reg bya'i tshogs// rnam gsum reg bya'i rdo rje mar byas nas// dkyil 'khor lha yi lus la dbul bar bgyi// rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs 'bul ba'i tshul dang*/ oṃ āḥspar+she badz+rī hūm̐/ zhes pas reg bya rnams dbul lo// gzugs sogs yul lnga po rnams rdo rje ma lngar bsgoms la des dkyil 'khor mchod par bsam mo// ma rgyud kyi mchod phreng ni/ bde mchog lū hi pa nas gsungs pa ni/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na// lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la dbul bar bgyi// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sam+ba ra maṇ+ḍa la tsakra sarba wī ra yo gi nī ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon dang*/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ lha rdzas zhabs bsil/ pā d+yaṃ/ lha rdzas me tog badz+ra puṣ+pe/ lha rdzas bdug spos/ badz+ra dhū pe/ lha rdzas snang gsal/ badz+ra ā lo ke/ lha rdzas dri mchog badz+ra gan+dhe/ lha rdzas zhal zas/ badz+ra nai wi d+ya/ lha rdzas rol mo/ ḍa ma rus mgo drangs pa'i rol chen dang bcas rdo rje snying gar bzung*/ dril bu rgyun chags su gsil bas/ oṃ badz+ra ghāṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta sogs brjod/ na bza'i mchod pa ni/ gos zung bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gos srab pa 'jam pa yang ba zung du sbyar ba dang ldan par gyur/ ces byin gyis brlabs la/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos// mi phyed rdo rje'i sku la gsol// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na// bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs/ badz+ra was+t+rū āḥhūm̐/ zhes pad kor sngon du 'gro bas gos zung blangs te mdun nas smad g.yogs dang*/ rgyab nas stod g.yogs bskon pa'i tshul bya zhing lha re re la na bza' zung re phul bar bsam/

rig ma bcu drug ni/ oṃ wī ṇi badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥ zhes pas rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las lha mo pi waṃ ma sngon mo pi waṃ thogs pa phyung*/ dpag tu med par gyur nas dkyil 'khor pa rnams mchod par bsam zhing*/ dbang sngon mdog mtshungs rdo rje pi wang ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis mngon sprul te// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs pi wang sgra yis mchod// sngags kyi thog mtha' 'dra bas/ wī ṇī badz+ri nī badz+rā/ zhes dang*/ lag pa gnyis kyis pi wang dkrol ba'i tshul bya/ oṃ waṃ se badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥs gling bu ma ser mo gling bu 'dzin pa phyung la/ gser bzang mdog mtshungs rdo rje gling bu ma// tshig rkang tha ma gsum 'dra ba la/ gling bu'i sgra yis mchod/ waṃ se badz+ri nī/ zhes dang kha 'gram g.yas thad du gling bu bsgyur tshul bya/ oṃ mṛ daṅga badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥs rdza rnga ma dmar mo rdza rnga thogs pa phyung la/ pad+ma rā ga'i mdog mtshungs rdza rnga ma// rdza rnga'i sgra yis mchod/ mṛ daṅga badz+ri nī/ zhes dang lag gnyis res mos kyis steng nas brdung tshul bya/ oṃ murdzi badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥs rnga zlum ma ljang gu rnga zlum 'dzin pa phyung la/ margad mdog mtshungs rdo rje rnga zlum ma// rnga zlum sgra yis mchod/ murdzi badz+ri nī/ zhes dang lag gnyis g.yas g.yon du gdengs te res mos kyis brdung ba'i tshul bya/ oṃ hā s+ye badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥs bzhad ma dmar mo khu tshur gnyis kha 'gram g.yas g.yon du bzhag pa phyung la/ li khri'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje bzhad pa ma// bzhad pa'i bde bas mchod/ hā s+ye badz+ri nī/ zhes dang sngar gyi phyag rgya bya/ oṃ lā s+ye badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥs sgeg mo rdo rje dang dril bu dku gnyis su 'dzin par phyung la/ nam mkha'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje sgeg mo ma// sgeg mdzes bde bas mchod/ lā s+ye badz+ri ni/ zhes dang sgeg mo'i phyag rgya sngar bzhin bya/

oṃ gī tī badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥs glu ma dmar mo ting ting shag 'dzin pa phyung la/ gur gum mdog mtshungs rdo rje glu len ma// snyan pa'i glu yis mchod/ gī tī badz+ri nī/ zhes dang ting shag brdung tshul bya/ 'di la pheg rdob kyang zer gsungs/ oṃ nṛ t+ye badz+ra nī hūm̐ āḥs gar ma ljang ser lag gnyis gar skor byed pa phyung la/ pri yaṅku mtshungs rdo rje gar mkhan ma// mdzes pa'i gar gyis mchod/ nṛ t+ye badz+ri nī/ zhes dang*/ lag gnyis g.yas g.yon du bsgyur ba'i gar skor byas la rdo rje thal mo sbyar zhing bskor/ oṃ puṣ+pe badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥs me tog ma dkar mo me tog gi za ma tog 'dzin pa phyung la/ zla ba'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje me tog ma// me tog sil mas mchod/ puṣ+pe badz+ri nī/ zhes dang g.yon pa rdo rje khu tshur gyen bstan za ma tog 'dzin pa lta bu dang*/ g.yas rdo rje khu tshur gyis de nas blangs te 'thor pa'i tshul bya/ oṃ dhū paṃ badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥs bdug spos ma sngon mo spos snod 'dzin pa phyung la/ in+d+ra nī la'i mdog mtshungs bdug spos ma// bdug pa'i sprin gyis mchod/ dhū paṃ badz+ri nī/ zhes dang lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur thur bstan blug pa'i tshul bya/ oṃ dī paṃ badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥs mar me ma dmar mo mar me'i kong bu 'dzin pa phyung la/ nyi ma'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje mar me ma// mar me'i phreng bas mchod/ dī paṃ badz+ri nī/ zhes dang rdo rje khu tshur gnyis gshibs la mthe bong gyen du bsgreng*/ oṃ gan+dhe badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥs dri chab ma ljang gu dri'i dung chos 'dzin pa phyung la/ gan+dhe'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje dri chab ma// dri bzang byug pas mchod/ gan+dhe badz+ri nī/ zhes dang*/ g.yon pa'i mtheb mdzub sbyar zhing lhag gsum brkyang pa kha gyen bstan dung gi phyag rgya dang*/ g.yas de lta bu gyen du bslangs pas byug pa'i tshul bya/

mchod phreng snga ma rnams su dri chab ma ljang gur bshad pa da lta'i ngag 'don dang ma mthun pa slar dpyad/ oṃ rū pa badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥs gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo me long thogs pa phyung la/ chu shel mdog mtshungs gzugs kyi rdo rje ma// gzugs kyi bde bas mchod/ rū pa badz+ri nī/ zhes dang g.yon rdo rje khu tshur gyi tshigs gsum pa'i steng du g.yas pa'i thal mo gyen bslangs kha phyir bstan te bzhag oṃ sa ra badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥs ro rdo rje dmar mo zhal zas kyis bkang ba'i snod 'dzin pa phyung la/ btsod kyi mdog mtshungs ro yi rdo rje ma// ro yi bde bas mchod/ ra sa badz+ri nī/ zhes dang rdo rje thal mo gyen du phye/ oṃ spar+she badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥs reg rdo rje ma ljang gu sna tshogs pa'i gos 'dzin pa phyung la/ sna tshogs mdog mtshungs reg bya rdo rje ma// reg bya'i bde bas mchod/ spar+she badz+ra nī/ zhes dang rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis gos 'bul tshul bya'o// oṃ dharmā dhā tu badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥs chos dbyings rdo rje ma dkar mo chos 'byung thogs pa spros la/ ston zla'i mdog mtshungs chos dbyings rdo rje ma// chos khams bde bas mchod/ dharmā dhā tu badz+ri nī/ zhes dang rdo rje bsdams pa las mthe bong dang mdzub mo dang mthe chung rnams brkyangs te rtse sprad pa'am/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis gshibs gung mo brkyangs te rtse sprad pa gang rung bya'o// rin chen bdun ni/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las rin chen sna bdun spros te dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la mchod par bsams la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la// sogs spyi ltar la/ pū dzi te hūm̐ gi gong du badz+ra mi sbyar ba khyad par ro// de dag gi phyag rgya ni/ 'khor lo lag pa gnyis rgyab sbyar sor mo rnams phan tshun 'khyud cing mthe bong lag mthil du bkug nor bu la khu tshur gnyis sbyar la gung mo gnyis brkyangs te rtse sprad/

mdzub mo'i tshigs bcag la mthe bong dag dang sbyar/ btsun mo la rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo sbyar ba brkyangs pa'i tshigs dang por mdzub mo gnyis sbyar/ blon po la rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis sbyar ba brkyang*/ mthe bong dang mthe'u chung so sor bsgreng*/ glang po la lag g.yas glang po'i sna ltar brkyangs pa'i gru mo g.yon pa'i thal mos brten/ rta mchog la khu tshur gnyis sbyar la mthe bong so sor dbye/ gung mo dang srin lag gshibs te brkyang*/ dmag dpon la g.yon snying gar phub 'dzin pa'i tshul dang*/ g.yas pas ral gri 'debs pa'i tshul byas te dbul lo// 'dod yon lnga ni/ dngos su bshams pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med pa na yod pa'i gzugs sogs lnga po 'bul bar mos la/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis rnams// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba sogs nas yo gi nī rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pu dza te hūm̐/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar bas dbul/ shab+da la/ dung dang cha lang cang te'u sogs rol mo ji snyed pa dkrol/ gan+dhe la/ gong gi dri rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya bya/ ra sa la rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya bya/ spar+she la/ reg rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya bya ba sogs tshig spyi ltar gyis dbul/ bde mchog rnams la/ yid las byung ba'i mchod pa ni/ spyi bor thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba las sor mo rnams kyi tshigs dbus ma bcag pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas nas/ mchod pa'i sprin byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba lta bus nam mkha'i khams gang bas mchod par bsams te/ ngag tu/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin gyis brlabs dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin gyis brlabs dang*/

gsang sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthu dang*/ bdag gi mos pa dang ting nge 'dzin dang smon lam gyi dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed yod pa dang*/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig ces brjod la se gol brdab/ yang phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ sarba bita pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā brta ya ā brta ya ho/ na maḥs man+ta bud dhā nāṃ/ a bhi sma ra ye/ s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ dharmā dhā tu ā kā sha sa man+ta māṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ri sho dha ye/ maṇ+ḍa le ma ma pra ṇi dhi/ puṇ+ya dz+nyā na ba le na/ sarba ta thā ga ta ba len+dha/ ban+dha swa s+tha na ba le na tsa ye swā hā/ zhes brjod de se gol brdab/ yang phyag rgya dang bcas te se gol brdab pa yid byung gi mchod pa'o// rkang brgyad ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti wī re shā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kalpa ag+ni san+ni bhā ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dza ṭa ma ku ṭot+ka ṭā ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ daṃṣ+ṭā ka rā lo gra bhī ṣa na mu khā ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sa ha sra bhu dza bhā su rā ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pa ra shu pā sho d+ya ta shū la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dhā ri ṇe hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ byā gh+rā dzi na am+ba rā dha rā ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā dhūm+ba an+dha kā ra wa pu ṣa ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti badz+ra wā hā hī bam̐ hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo ār+ya a pa rā dzi te trai lo kya mā te ma hā bi d+ye shwa ri hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥsarba bhū ta bha ya ba he ma hā badz+re hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra ā sa na/ a dzi te a pa rā dzi te ba sh+yaṃ ka ri ne tra bha ma ṇi hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ na mo bi ṣa ṇi sho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dhi ka ra li ni hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mas+t+ra sa ni mā rā ṇi pra bhe da ni a pa rā dza ye hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzam+bha ni stam+bha ni mo ha ni hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra wā rā hī ma hā yo gi nī kā me shwa ri kha ge hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ces brjod/ gnyis med rgyud kyi mchod phreng la/ dus 'khor ni/ dri med dag cing yid 'ong ba// sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyis// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// ces brjod nas pad kor sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ grī kā la tsakra i daṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa ar+ghaṃ kam̐ mam̐ pu na ri yam̐/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad dang sngags kyi thog mtha' sbyar te/ sngags kyi zhabs bsil mchog 'di dag /pā d+yaṃ/ sngags kyi bsang gtor mchog 'di dag /prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ sngags kyi zhal bsil mchog 'di dag /āñtsa ma naṃ// gsol ba 'debs pa'i chu bzhi dbul ba ni/ rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho khams gsum pa'i dbang phyug /dus kyi 'khor lo mchod yon so sor bzhes// bcom ldan 'das khyed 'khor dang bcas pa yis// bdag dang sems can rnams la mchog stsol mdzod// ces brjod nas pad kor sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ āḥhum̐ hūm̐ trai dhā tu kai shwa ra kā la tsakra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha sa pa ri wā ra bha ga wān me ba ra do bha ba shi ṣ+ya naṃ tsa/ de bzhin du sngags dang tshigs bcad thog mtha' sbyar te/ dus kyi 'khor lo zhabs bsil so sor bzhes// pā d+yaṃ/ dus kyi 'khor lo bsang gtor so sor bzhes/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ dus kyi 'khor lo zhal bsil so sor bzhes// āñtsa ma naṃ/ zhes sngar ltar sngags rgyar bcas pas dbul lo// nyer spyod lnga ni/ de'ang tshigs bcad brjod pa'i tshe don dran bzhin pas rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar/ oṃ nas sa pa ri wā ra brjod pa'i bar lus kyis rdo rje thal mo bkrol la pad+ma'i bskor ba bya/

yid kyis sngags don bzhin mchod bya'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha gsal gdab/ i daṃ gan+dhaṃ sogs brjod pa'i tshe lag pas dri chab la sogs pa'i so so'i phyag rgya bya zhing snying ga nas spros pa'i mchod pa'i lhas dri chab la sogs pa'i mchod pa byas par bsam/ pra tīts+tsha na maḥbarjod pa'i tshe lha rnams kyis mchod pa dag so sor bzhes te mnyes par bsams la lag pa rdo rje bsdu ba'i tshul gyi se gol gtogs la snying ga nas spros pa'i lha tshur bsdu'o// de ni 'og ma kun la shes par bya'o// 'di ni dri bzang dge ba ste// dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa// bdag ni dad pas 'bul lags kyi// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥshrī kā la tsakra sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ gan+dhe da dā ma he badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ zhes pas dri dang*/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad kyi mtha' ma gnyis dang*/ sngags kyi thog ma sbyar te/ me tog 'di ni bzang zhing dge /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa/ puṣ+paṃ da dā ma he badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ zhes pas me tog dang*/ tshal dag ro ni phan pa dang*// gang zhig dri dang bdug spos rnams// dhū pa da dā ma he badz+ra dhū pa pra tīts+tsha na maḥ zhes pas bdug spos dang*/ srin po 'joms shing dag byed pa// dge zhing mun sel mar me 'di// dī paṃ da dā ma he badz+ra dī paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ zhes pas mar me dang*/ bza' dang bca' bar yang dag ldan// kha dog dri dang ro ldan ni// nai bi d+ye dang ma he badz+ra ni bid+yā pra tīts+tsha na maḥ zhes pas zhal zas dang*/ sil snyan la sogs rol mo'i tshogs// dbyangs kyi nga ro ldan pa 'di// bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyi// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta nas/ badz+ra satwa hṛ da ya san+to ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥhoḥhoḥswā hā/ zhes pas dril bu gsil zhing rol mo 'bul lo// rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kha gyen du bstan nas me tog 'thor ba'i tshul ni me tog gi phyag rgya yin la/

gzhan sngar dang 'dra'o// kye rdor ni/ dri med yid 'ong sogs dus 'khor dang phal cher 'dra'o// de dag ni mtshan pa tsam ste/ dkyil 'khor chen po rnams kyi mchod phreng rgyas pa ni 'brir mi long la/ lhan skyes dang*/ dpa' gcig la ni mchod phreng sne re re tsam btang bas chog go /zhes pa'ang rje bla ma de nyid kyi bzhed skong du rgyud sde'i dkyil chog rnams las blo gter gyis btus pa dge/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
